_comment: BEC investigation case file. Copy this, fill it in during the investigation, then render with: python3 scripts/process.py report --case case.json --out bec-report.html . Any value you cannot establish stays the literal string UNKNOWN - it renders as UNKNOWN in the report rather than blocking it. Never guess a value.

baseline._comment: Known-good values supplied by the analyst, the user's manager, or IT asset inventory. Do NOT derive these from the logs under investigation.

observed._comment: What the sign-in telemetry actually shows for the suspicious activity.

signins._comment: One entry per notable sign-in. Delete this example row.

ioc_enrichment._comment: One entry per indicator checked via the threat-intel MCP server. Record negatives too - 'checked, no hits' differs from 'not checked'. Delete this example row.

asn_assessment._comment: Analyst judgement per standards.md criteria - not a tool verdict. The MPC server has no ASN lookup tool; isp/usageType come from AbuseIPDB and GreyNoise inside threatintel_lookup_ip.

mailbox_persistence._comment: Inbox rules, delegate permissions, forwarding. Delete this example row.
mailbox_persistence.name: UNKNOWN

files_viewed._comment: Viewed but not downloaded - still exposure. Delete this example row.

graph_activity._comment: Suspicious Microsoft Graph API calls, consent grants, service principals. Delete this example row.

timeline._comment: Every source merged, ordered by UTC timestamp. Delete this example row.

metrics._comment: Leave UNKNOWN rather than estimating - an estimated compromise time silently changes the dwell-time headline.

recommendations._comment: Every row needs an owner and a deadline or it will not get done. Horizon: Immediate | Short-term | Long-term. Delete this example row.

evidence_notes: Record here any data source that was unavailable (licence, retention gap) - an absence of evidence is a finding and must not read as an absence of activity.
